projectDescription: An open source library resource discovery portal that enables patrons to search and browse library catalogs, institutional repositories, and external databases through a unified, customizable interface.
keyFeatures: Unified search across Solr, EDS, Primo, Summon, WorldCat and 20+ other backends
Supports 30+ ILS (Integrated Library System) drivers including Folio, Koha, Sierra, Alma, and Voyager
Multiple authentication methods: LDAP, Shibboleth, CAS, OpenID Connect, ILS-native
Fully customizable Bootstrap 5 theming system with local override support
Built-in OAI-PMH harvesting and MARC record import pipeline
REST API with Swagger UI for search, records, authority data, and admin functions
Recommendation engine with faceted browsing and relevance ranking
Online payment integration (Stripe, Paytrail) for library fines
publicApiSurface: GET /api/v1/search — Full-text search across configured backends
GET /api/v1/record/{id} — Retrieve a single bibliographic record
GET /api/v1/records — Retrieve multiple records by ID
GET /api/v1/authority/record/{id} — Retrieve a single authority record
ILS\Driver\DriverInterface — Interface for integrating a new ILS system
Auth\AuthInterface — Interface for implementing a custom authentication handler
Recommend\RecommendInterface — Interface for adding custom recommendation modules
RecordTab\TabInterface — Interface for adding custom record detail tabs
Search\BackendManager — Service managing search backend registration
